title: Embracing Challenges: Growing Through New Experiences
text: Explore how taking on challenges helps build resilience, develop confidence, and support personal growth.
cdi_links: 3.G.03 Recognising how challenges and experiences support personal development

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: What resilience means and why it matters
How personal challenges help you grow
What happens when you step outside your comfort zone
How new experiences build confidence and skills

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what resilience means
I can describe a personal challenge
I can explain how growth happens through experience
I can reflect on stepping outside my comfort zone

title: Key Words
bullets: Resilience – Keeping going, even when things are difficult
Personal Challenge – Something you find difficult but want to try
Growth – Becoming stronger, wiser, or more confident through experience
Comfort Zone – A situation where you feel safe; stepping outside it helps you grow

title: Quick Questions
text: What is something you have found difficult but kept trying?
What happens when you try something new?
Why might it be important to challenge yourself?

title: Personal Challenges
bullets: Trying new things can feel uncomfortable, but it helps you grow
A personal challenge is something difficult that you choose to try
Resilience means continuing even when something is hard
Each challenge builds confidence and strength
Examples include speaking in public, trying a new activity, or asking questions

title: Growth and Learning
bullets: Growth happens when you learn from experiences
It is not just about success or failure, but about learning
Stepping outside your comfort zone helps you discover new strengths
Reflection helps you understand what you have learned

title: Activity
text: Take part in activities that explore personal challenges, stepping outside your comfort zone, and building resilience. This includes reflection, problem-solving, and identifying ways to overcome difficulties when trying something new.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Resilience helps you keep going when things are difficult
Personal challenges support growth and confidence
Stepping outside your comfort zone helps you learn new skills
Learning from experience is more important than avoiding failure
